CUHK Centre for Quality of Life quarterly reports exist on a web archive (webarchive.lib.cuhk.edu.hk) for 2000-2017ish but the archive returns a bot-check page to automated fetches (confirmed again after WebFetch quota reset); only 9 quarters (2010-09,2013-09,2014-06,2014-09,2014-12,2015-09,2016-09,2017-09,2018-01) could be matched to both a value and an exact PDF URL via search-engine snippets. 2011-2012 point values were mentioned in search summaries but without a confirmed single matching PDF URL, so not transcribed
No evidence found that CUHK continued this quarterly survey past approximately Jan 2018; no later reports or press mentions located
